basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old mental health advocate based in Portland, Oregon. My background is in psychology, and I work part-time at a local nonprofit supporting underprivileged youth. I’m also a big fan of board games, cooking, and hiking the beautiful trails of the Pacific Northwest. In my downtime, you can find me browsing Reddit in the evenings, usually between 7 PM and 11 PM PST. I'm currently single, focusing on personal growth and community engagement.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Psychology, and I am currently pursuing a Master's in Social Work. I frequently engage in self-study through online courses and am actively involved in community workshops. My professional and volunteer experiences have given me practical insights into mental health and social services.
